title: Span cost setter must not overwrite an LLM_COST that was already set, including explicit null
answers: manually set span cost gets overwritten by calculated cost
custom cost ignored on trace in SageMaker
null cost on a span replaced with a calculated price
cost passed by the user disappears in the MLflow UI
body:
Symptom: a cost the user set on a span (or deliberately set to null) is replaced by MLflow's calculated price after the span ends.
Root cause: mlflow/tracing/utils/__init__.py:set_span_cost_attribute used to compute and set LLM_COST unconditionally once client-side cost was enabled.
Fix pattern: return early when SpanAttributeKey.LLM_COST is a key in span._span.attributes. Check key presence, not truthiness, so an explicit null is kept.
Constraints: the server-side path also keeps an existing LLM_COST. See test_translate_preserves_client_computed_cost in tests/tracing/otel/test_span_translation.py. Keep this guard in place if the setter is refactored.
applies: Span cost computation on LiveSpan.end() and the server-side translate_span_when_storing path.
says: Manually recorded model costs in trace details are overwritten by the system's estimated price.
Setting an empty cost on a trace step still displays an automatic dollar calculation.
Custom token expense values provided during inference disappear from the trace monitoring screen.
Preserve user-entered cost amounts instead of replacing them when a trace completes.
Do not recalculate pricing for trace runs where cost tracking was intentionally cleared.
search: When computing span costs, `set_span_cost_attribute` in `mlflow/tracing/utils/__init__.py` must not overwrite an existing `LLM_COST` attribute, including an explicit null value. The setter checks for key presence in `span._span.attributes` rather than truthiness and returns early to preserve manual or client-computed costs. This applies to cost computation during `LiveSpan.end()` and server-side translation in `translate_span_when_storing`. Verified by `test_sagemaker_preserves_manual_cost_when_span_ends` in `tests/tracing/utils/test_utils.py` and `test_translate_preserves_client_computed_cost` in `tests/tracing/otel/test_span_translation.py`.
